description: This file contains extension methods for configuring grain call filters in the Orleans hosting framework, specifically for adding incoming and outgoing grain call filters to the silo builder pipeline.

classes.name: GrainCallFilterSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to add grain call filters to the ISiloBuilder in Orleans.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter instance to the filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter implementation of type TImplementation to the filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IncomingGrainCallFilterDelegate to the filter pipeline via a builder extension method.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IOutgoingGrainCallFilter instance to the filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter implementation of type TImplementation to the filter pipeline.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an OutgoingGrainCallFilterDelegate to the filter pipeline via a builder extension method.
